title: NeoHaskell · Assembly Guide, pushed further
question: Four new directions build on Assembly Guide’s clarity. Choose one, combine specific elements in the note, or request another round.

options.label: The living specification
options.lineage: Interactive type specimens and precise technical notation
options.thesis: Let the words and rules of an application become the visual structure.
options.viewport: An enormous typographic statement gives way to a full-width annotated behavior, with setup built into the reading path.
options.risk: The strict typographic treatment can feel austere without inviting language.

options.label: The developer workshop
options.lineage: stripe.dev’s developer culture, reframed as an assembly guide
options.thesis: A confident workshop for turning an idea into a clear, inspectable application.
options.viewport: Large welcoming type opens into an annotated construction diagram and a direct installation entry.
options.risk: Technical detail must remain welcoming to builders who are new to the language.

options.label: Built in full color
options.lineage: The logo’s cyan and violet geometry, expanded into a playful construction system
options.thesis: Building feels approachable when the pieces and their relationships are tangible.
options.viewport: One vivid construction sequence carries the idea, the rules, the resulting behavior, and an inviting setup action.
options.risk: Playfulness must stay purposeful and avoid toy-like or generic AI imagery.

options.label: The open systems atlas
options.lineage: Antikythera’s editorial columns, archival panels, and graphic intensity
options.thesis: Treat NeoHaskell as a practical body of ideas visitors can enter from a clear starting point.
options.viewport: Three unequal columns place the guided start beside an annotated application model and concise explanations.
options.risk: The editorial density needs a clearly dominant starting action to stay approachable.

canonCard.label: A quiet, polished guide
canonCard.thesis: Keep a familiar developer-homepage structure and refine its finish.
canonCard.viewport: A direct product introduction and setup action lead into a simple application diagram.
canonCard.risk: Approachable and familiar, with less visual distinction than the exploratory directions.
